text:
SOUTH INDIAN SONGS have been my first love, though only after the retro playlists, but the sequence you put up here is really addictivee 😭🤌
Chuttamalle started off with sweet lovey dovey vibes 🫠🩷
Othiyadi came to keep up the vibe, adding thicker melody, and that feeling when one misses the other 💛🙂‍↔️
Vacchidamma then sounded like an incomplete attachment, both trying to connect, but help apart by some natural force ❤️‍🩹🫠
And Patthavaikum exactly the opposite of vacchidamma - Two souls trying to go apart, but pulled closer each time 😭🤌
Unakkul Naane - (pure goosebumps) don't know why, but gave vibes of classical dance 🥺, sounded like her, dancing, and he be admiring her from afar, both be maintaining constant eye contact throughout the performance 🫠🩷

Inkem inkem - shows how he feels as he imagines and writes about her, smiling to himself the more he thinks about her.🙂‍↔️

Tum tum - sounded like - She comes in his dreams and plays fun pranks, disturbs him, from sleep and teases him 😌

Manasulone Nilichipoke - sounded like -  He wakes up and realises it was a dream, and falls back to bed, smiling 🫠

Katchi Sera - In the college classroom, he keeps admiring, dreaming of her from his bench (afar), misses his roll call and the teacher throws a chalk, waking him up from the illusion 🫠🤧

(Now few years later, when they are working as colleagues in the same office, both good friends, as they were in childhood)

Kurumugil - They meet few days later and they go for a walk together by the sea coasts near their town, he tells her that  his family was looking for a girl for his wedding and that the following Sunday he'd be visiting the girl's house 💔🫠

Adiye - She feels sad at the news and didn't talk much, just congratulated him quietly, and said she was happy for him. Both didn't talk for the next few days.

Aasa kooda - She missed him a lot for these few days, slept late at nights, thinking about him. 

Then, It was Sunday morning, and she slept late. Her mother rushed to wake her up,"Get up already, it's 10 AM. They  are here, get up, get dressed, i want you downstairs in only 10 minutes okay??" 

She was feeling frustrated, but somehow walked downstairs silently and still half asleep, as she entered the living room, she couldn't believe her eyes,
HE WAS THERE WITH HIS FAMILY 👀.

Hey Minnale - She felt confused and ran back upstairs, and locked herself in her bedroom. 
She could hear everyone downstairs, her father, mother and his family all laughing. A few minutes later someone knocked on her bedroom door.
"It's me", he spoke.
"What do you want?"
"Why? I came to see you", he teased.
"Why do you wish to see me?"
"You remember, today's Sunday?", he replied 
"So what?", (she shouted from inside, her face buried in pillows)
"Won't I see my wife?"
"Huh?", she suddenly recalled what he had said and it all dawned upon her what he must have meant.
"Seems like my wife is busy", he teased and acted like walking back, creating false footsteps. 🥲🤧

Matudaani - She runs to open the door to stop him, expecting he must have gone down, and right after opening the door, knocked against him, due to the force, and he fell down, she fell over him.
"Shitt", she hid her face.
"Oyee, why to shyy away from me?"
"What was all that drama for?" She demanded.
"Umm, hehe 😅 Just tried to surprise you."
She stared mischievously at him, "You're a rat, a spoiled rat."
"Now now", he began, "Help me get up, I'll be crushed under your weight"
"Huh" she rolled her eyes and they got up.
"Okay, come fast, mom। and dad are waiting for you", he called and laughed. 
"Haa haa sure, let me get dressed". 🤧🙄

Kalyani - As she comes downstairs, He began staring at her like a baby stares at his mother.
Her open hairs, golden brown eyes, little black bindi, peach coloured jhumkas, ocean blue flowing saree, all, he just couldn't stop looking at her 🫠🤌❤️‍🩹

 Minnalvala - Both families approved each other and everything was fixed. A date was selected for their wedding and processions begun to be called for the decorations 🩷👀

Vaseegara - Everything done, all rituals carried out happily, and finally they were one.
Just as the pheras were completed, she was teary eyed and looked up to him, clinging to him, pulling him by the knot, tied between her saree and his sherwani, he understood, she needed to feel light and hugged her, and she wept like a baby in his arms, finding her world in him 🥺❤️‍🩹

Munbe Vaa - Years passed, and now they are  more than just two people. They have a three year old between them, the latter getting more of his mother's time and the former getting jealous of it 😂🩷

Nenjukkul Peidhidum - I just have no more words, Hope they live happily, safe and live together till the end of eternity 🫠🩷

Aww 🥺❤️ first of all don’t panic, this happens with sooo many dance cover channels, especially when copyrighted songs are involved 🪷

If YouTube is not allowing the video to be public, it usually means one of these things happened:
1) the copyright owner blocked the song in your country/worldwide. 
2) the combination of multiple songs triggered stricter copyright rules.
3) sometimes long performances get detected even if it’s just background/performance audio.

But no, it does NOT always mean you have to delete the whole video 🫶

You can try these things:
🌷 check the “Restrictions” section in YouTube Studio carefully...
— if it says “Blocked” then sadly that version can’t be public unless you edit it.
— if it says “Copyright claim” only then the video can usually stay up but monetization goes to the owner.

🌷 try trimming/muting the exact copyrighted parts using YouTube Editor. Sometimes even removing a small section fixes the issue ✨

🌷 if there are 2-3 songs together, one specific song might be causing the block. You can test by editing or replacing that section only.

🌷 You can also upload it as Shorts/Reels in smaller parts sometimes those get less strict detection 🪷

And please don’t feel discouraged 💕 dance covers and performance videos get copyrighted VERY easily, even when it’s your own choreography or live performance recording. It happens to so many creators🫶🏻
Hope your video works out soon 🤍✨
